//@version=6
indicator("LuxQuant - Swing Points & VWAP - micky v1.0", "LuxQuant - Swing Points & VWAP - micky v1.0", overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500)

// --- Inputs ---
int swingLength = input.int(5, "Swing Length", minval = 1, tooltip = "Number of bars to the left and right to confirm a swing point")

string anchor = input.string("Custom Time", "VWAP Anchor", options = ["Session", "Week", "Month", "Year", "Custom Time"])
string customSession = input.session("0930-1600", "Custom Session (for Custom Time anchor)")
string tz = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone (for Custom Time anchor)")

bool showBands = input.bool(true, "Show VWAP Bands", group = "VWAP Bands")
float mult1 = input.float(1.0, "Multiplier 1", group = "VWAP Bands")
float mult2 = input.float(2.0, "Multiplier 2", group = "VWAP Bands")
float mult3 = input.float(3.0, "Multiplier 3", group = "VWAP Bands")

bool showReset = input.bool(true, "Highlight Reset Bar", group = "Style")

// --- Colors ---
color colBull = #089981
color colBear = #f23645
color colVwap = #5b9cf6
color colBands = color.new(color.gray, 50)
color colReset = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 85), "Reset Color", group = "Style")

// --- VWAP Calculation ---
bool isNewAnchor = false
if anchor == "Custom Time"
    // Triggers on the first bar of the custom session every day
    isNewAnchor := na(time(timeframe.period, customSession, tz)[1]) and not na(time(timeframe.period, customSession, tz))
else
    isNewAnchor := switch anchor
        "Session" => timeframe.change("D")
        "Week"    => timeframe.change("W")
        "Month"   => timeframe.change("M")
        "Year"    => timeframe.change("Y")
        => false

float vwapValue = na
float stdevValue = na

if anchor == "Session"
    [v, u, l] = ta.vwap(hlcc4, isNewAnchor, 1)
    vwapValue := v
    // Approximation or custom calculation for stdev is needed if we want multiple bands without multiple ta.vwap calls
    // Actually, we can compute it manually for all anchors to have full control.
    
float sumSrcVol = 0.0
float sumVol = 0.0
float sumSrcSrcVol = 0.0

sumSrcVol := isNewAnchor ? hlcc4 * volume : nz(sumSrcVol[1]) + hlcc4 * volume
sumVol    := isNewAnchor ? volume : nz(sumVol[1]) + volume
sumSrcSrcVol := isNewAnchor ? volume * math.pow(hlcc4, 2) : nz(sumSrcSrcVol[1]) + volume * math.pow(hlcc4, 2)

vwapValue := sumSrcVol / sumVol
float variance = math.max(0, sumSrcSrcVol / sumVol - math.pow(vwapValue, 2))
stdevValue := math.sqrt(variance)

// --- Swing Points ---
float ph = ta.pivothigh(high, swingLength, swingLength)
float pl = ta.pivotlow(low, swingLength, swingLength)

// --- Plotting ---
// VWAP
plot(vwapValue, "VWAP", color = colVwap, linewidth = 2)

// VWAP Bands
plot(showBands ? vwapValue + stdevValue * mult1 : na, "Upper Band 1", color = colBands)
plot(showBands ? vwapValue - stdevValue * mult1 : na, "Lower Band 1", color = colBands)
plot(showBands ? vwapValue + stdevValue * mult2 : na, "Upper Band 2", color = colBands)
plot(showBands ? vwapValue - stdevValue * mult2 : na, "Lower Band 2", color = colBands)
plot(showBands ? vwapValue + stdevValue * mult3 : na, "Upper Band 3", color = colBands)
plot(showBands ? vwapValue - stdevValue * mult3 : na, "Lower Band 3", color = colBands)

// Swing Points
plotshape(ph, "Swing High", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, colBear, -swingLength, size = size.small)
plotshape(pl, "Swing Low", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, colBull, -swingLength, size = size.small)

// Reset Highlight
bgcolor(showReset and isNewAnchor ? colReset : na, title = "VWAP Reset Highlight")
